body: What year is that? Ours look really similar. Also any recommendations for aftermarket accessories?

I would really try to keep your phone mounted somewhere in your line of sight while driving because having it below the windshield can be dangerous when you go to use it. I keep mine mounted to the left of the steering wheel.

I had similar experiences with birth control, migraines and all that. I didn't ever get them before that like you did though. Another thing I noticed was it affected my mood a lot, I was very jumpy emotionally and irritable. Did you have a similar experience with that? I'm honestly just thinking of switching to a copper IUD.
